title: Vendor inventory export
description: Current vendor inventory with tier, criticality per service, data classes and owner.

title: Inventory reconciliation report
description: Quarterly reconciliation results listing unrecorded vendors found and their disposition.

title: Vendor due diligence file
description: Per vendor and tier: completed checks, findings, approver and date.

title: Integration approval gate records
description: Records of blocked and approved new egress destinations, OAuth apps and data-processing dependencies with linked vendor approvals.

title: Contract term checklist and gap acceptances
description: Per critical vendor: required terms present or absent, with risk acceptance records for gaps.

title: SOC report review records and CUEC mapping
description: Per vendor report: scope, period, opinion, exceptions, CUEC-to-control mapping, bridge letter status and compensating procedures.

title: Vendor signal log and review triggers
description: Logged signals for critical vendors and resulting out-of-cycle reviews and issues.

title: Dependency and concentration map
description: Map of services to vendors and fourth parties with concentration measures and tolerances.

title: Exit plans and rehearsal results
description: Exit plan per critical vendor and dated rehearsal results with time to restore and gaps found.

title: TPRM policy and independent review report
description: Approved policy version and independent review findings with remediation.
